cues: As data goes down the stack at the sender, each layer wraps it in its own header.
Transport adds port numbers to make a segment.
Network adds IP addresses to make a packet.
Data link adds MAC addresses and a checksum to make a frame.
The physical layer sends it as bits.
At the receiver, each layer strips its header off on the way up.
text: As data goes down the stack at the sender, each layer wraps it in its own header. Transport adds port numbers to make a segment. Network adds IP addresses to make a packet. Data link adds MAC addresses and a checksum to make a frame. The physical layer sends it as bits. At the receiver, each layer strips its header off on the way up. This wrapping is called encapsulation.
